newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia revises '96 net grain harvest to 69.3 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Russia revises '96 net grain harvest to 69.3 mln T.

text.p: Russia has revised its 1996 net grain harvest up to 69.3 million tonnes from 69.0 million, Interfax news agency said on Friday, quoting revised and final figures from the State Statistics Committee.
It said the 1996 net wheat harvest was 34.9 million tonnes after 30.1 million in 1995.
The committee said the 1996 gross grain harvest was 76.1 million tonnes.
The 1995 net grain harvest was officially 63.4 million tonnes.
The committee said 1996 rye output rose 45 percent to 5.9 million tonnes. Barley output edged up one percent on a year ago to 15.9 million tonnes.
Average grain yields in 1996 were 1.29 tonnes per hectare against 1.16 tonnes in 1995. Average grain yields over 1991-1995 were 1.48 tonnes per hectare.
